calls.video_title: A Dip Like This Only Comes Once a Decade
calls.price_at_call: 3-yr forecast just over $2,500 per $1,000; medium-low confidence
calls.thesis: CONDITIONAL_BUY (prior tracked note was UNCERTAIN, a no-call, so no flip flagged) — pure-play flash "pantry"; data-centre sales +60% in three months, now over 40% of sales; 8-for-1 split on 20 Nov. CONDITIONAL_BUY — buy in pieces (dollar-cost average on the way down), not all at once; only while the memory shortage holds.
calls.base_case: Beat expectations ($49.50 vs ~$46 expected) on ~$11B sales, nearly 5x a year earlier; bought back ~$5B of stock in one quarter.
calls.bull_case: Data-centre flash demand keeps growing into the AI buildout.
calls.bear_case: Pantry is the first layer expected to loosen (supply catching demand in H2 2027, prices likely down); its own plan only calls for teens sales growth 2028-30.

calls.thesis: 'Pantry' memory for AI workloads; sales +175% to ~$20B, expected to double again, ~7x next-year earnings — market is pricing the bust as if it's already here. DCA because of volatility.
calls.bull_case: Data-center spend on SanDisk up ~14x YoY with ~$91B of signed multi-year contracts; memory may be structurally less cyclical this cycle.
calls.bear_case: Growth was mostly price hikes on 2/3 legacy business (phones/PCs/cards); long-term contracts cover only a quarter to a third of next year's sales; big funds cut ~30%.
